nodes.label: Real television, not an in-app simulation
nodes.details: Finished and watchable 15–30-minute episodes

nodes.label: Fast on-demand commissioning

nodes.label: Multi-device distribution
nodes.details: Web, phone and television playback

nodes.label: Only canon is law
nodes.details: Court's factual claims version-specific and evidence-grounded

nodes.label: Deep character fidelity

nodes.label: Archetype gestalt split
nodes.details: Cross-portrayal dossier is input; exact continuity-specific individual is output

nodes.label: Dynamic participant casting

nodes.label: Theatrical courtroom show
nodes.details: Recurring Jason, Matt, Jerry, Deadpool; witness drama; verdict; variable finishers

nodes.label: Intentional fourth-wall casting humor
nodes.details: Cross-franchise connections may be scripted without contaminating source lore

nodes.label: Single-source monorepo rebuild
nodes.details: Graph-first integration, preserving original repositories as evidence

nodes.label: No synthetic personhood claims as acceptance test
nodes.details: Prove behavior/performance and audit, not metaphysical personhood

nodes.label: Variant identity lock
nodes.details: MCU Tony never inherits Earth-616 exclusive history unless explicit crossover

nodes.label: Actor / role separation
nodes.details: RDJ, MCU Stark, portrayed Strauss, Chaplin and Doom all distinct and typed

nodes.label: Cite or abstain
nodes.details: Missing evidence leads to unresolved claim, not fabricated adjudication

nodes.label: Character fidelity stress matrix
nodes.details: Same event produces distinct, source-grounded behavior across Peter/Johnny/Hill/Tony

nodes.label: Echo creation/restart/reuse
nodes.details: Same pinned variant, versioned echo; no unapproved memory leakage

nodes.label: Continuity firewall
nodes.details: Nerd Court punishment never becomes original canon

nodes.label: Unavailable service fallback
nodes.details: Transparent job failure and no false claim of rendered output

nodes.label: Rendered episode acceptance
nodes.details: Decodable 15–30-minute A/V file, subtitles, continuity, finishers and complete duration

nodes.label: Real throughput/cost measurement
nodes.details: Timed cold/warm renders against stated fast turnaround

nodes.label: Web and TV player parity
nodes.details: Same published episode plays on web, mobile and television

nodes.label: Wiki source authority
nodes.details: Fandom/Wikipedia may contain unsourced cross-continuity summaries

nodes.label: Variant conflation
nodes.details: Current original UATU anchor merges multiversal identities

nodes.label: Character drift
nodes.details: Long generation may flatten psychologically distinct performers

nodes.label: Voice/likeness rights
nodes.details: Real performers and recognizable voices require production and publication review

nodes.label: Video output gap
nodes.details: Current Swift in-app playback does not demonstrate encoded 15–30-minute masters

nodes.label: Latency and cost
nodes.details: Couple-minute generation of long polished episode unproven

nodes.label: Large vendored/binary source corpus
nodes.details: Blind merging imports binaries, secrets, experimental tools, and licensing obligations

nodes.label: Historical design mismatch
nodes.details: May 2026 iOS/TestFlight blueprint differs from later web/TV product direction

nodes.label: Psychological attribution

nodes.label: Licensing and provenance
nodes.details: Third-party components, assets and research require license review before copying

nodes.label: Silent fallback masks lack of generation
nodes.details: Scripted output may be mistaken for independent model success
